name: 32109-raggedprefill-llama31-8b-1gpu
model: NousResearch/Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, bf16, unquantised. The ungated mirror of meta-llama/Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, under the Llama 3.1 Community License: same weights, same config.json, same tokenizer. ~16 GB of weights.
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3, SM90, one a3 node.
workload: guidellm synthetic_text, single turn, over /v1/completions. Every request carries the same 4096-token prefix (one bucket, prefix_count 1, prefix_tokens 4096), plus its own new prompt drawn uniformly from [64, 4096] (prompt_tokens 2048, min 64, max 4096, prompt_tokens_stdev unset, which is what makes the draw uniform rather than gaussian), and exactly 32 output tokens with ignore_eos and temperature 0.
purpose: A document question-answering assistant on one GPU, serving concurrent users short answers over a shared 4096-token policy document.
launch:
# `sglang serve` CLI form, read as a FLAT file: one `key: value` per line. A nested block is
# DROPPED silently, which would start the engine without a mechanism this file claims to declare.

model-path: NousResearch/Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct
tp-size: 1
attention-backend: triton
chunked-prefill-size: 16384
context-length: 16384
mem-fraction-static: 0.85
random-seed: 42
